text: Williams Hospital concentrates 100% of payouts into one account across 124 claims and four doctors, on a young 1.3-year registration - but its referrals are dispersed (top broker only 32.3%) and its patient-return profile is unremarkable. Payout concentration plus youth is worth a look; without a feeder pattern or footprint mismatch it stays low-severity. Growing hospitals genuinely do open with centralized treasury accounts. The alert exists so that an investigator sees the payout hub once, not to allege fraud by itself. Next step: a desk review of the payout account's ownership and whether the four doctors' claimed volumes match their registered schedules.
